title: Make is not only for compilers
objective: Chain two non-compilation targets so that make builds a report file before printing it.
hint: Any target can carry any shell command. Let the report target depend on the file it prints, so the file is produced first.

steps.description: the count is printed after the report is built
the intermediate file holds the line count
summary.txt is up to date, so it is not regenerated

lesson.goal: 把 make 看成依赖图执行器，而不只是编译器包装器。
lesson.prediction: make report 时，summary.txt 和 report 的顺序是什么？
hints: report 的 recipe 会读取 summary.txt，所以 report 应依赖它。
把依赖关系写在冒号右侧，recipe 只负责动作。
lesson.explanation: make 先递归构建前置条件，再执行目标 recipe；任何命令都可以成为 recipe。
